intent: Prove the architecture rule creation-reaches-its-collaborators-through-inversion with the dependency gate that enforces it.
observable_outcome: coverage lists the rule as proven by an architecture obligation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Interactive Skill creation does not import the Contexts it collaborates with, and none of them imports it. Everything it needs from the reference, admission and trial Contexts arrives as a narrow interface injected by a composition root, so the creation loop can be replaced or removed without any other Context changing.
